title: Trash/delete
description: This is a plugin that allows users to trash/delete items from their inventories
body: A lightweight utility plugin that provides players with a simple way to dispose of unwanted items through an interactive inventory interface. When opened, it presents a custom GUI where players can drop items they wish to delete. Upon closing the interface, all contents are permanently removed, helping keep inventories clean and reducing clutter without the need for external containers or manual disposal methods. Designed for ease of use and minimal server impact, this plugin adds a clean, intuitive solution for item management.
